title: The Landmarks on Chinese Money
synopsis: Learn about the various landmarks printed on Chinese banknotes.

fullText.simplified:
人民币上的风景

    钱币是一个国家的“名片”，在钱币上印制著名的风景，也是世界上比较流行的做法，因为人们可以通过这些风景展示一个国家的形象。人民币的反面也印制了中国非常著名的一些景点。
    在纸币一百元上印制的是北京人民大会堂。人民大会堂位于天安门广场的西面，是全国人民代表大会开会的地方。
    五十元纸币上的风景是西藏的布达拉宫。布达拉宫是世界上海拔最高的建筑，它建于1300年前，一共有1000间房屋。
    二十元纸币上印着的是广西的桂林山水。中国有句话——桂林山水甲天下，意思是桂林的风景是全国第一的。桂林也是很多人旅行计划中必去的一个地方。
    十元纸币上的风景是湖北的长江三峡。因为长江是中国的第一长河，长江三峡两边的山也非常雄奇。
    五元纸币上印着的是山东的泰山。有一位著名诗人曾经说过：“登上了泰山后，再看其他山都觉得很小了。”
    一元纸币上的风景是杭州西湖的三潭印月。三潭印月是西湖十景之一。据说在晚上月亮明亮的时候，潭里的灯光会倒映在水面形成假月亮。水面上真真假假的月亮形成了一道迷人的风景线。
    这些就是人民币纸币上的风景了。如果你有机会，可以一一去看一下。你还可以拿出相应的人民币与那里的风景合影呢！
fullText.traditional:
人民幣上的風景

    錢幣是一個國家的“名片”，在錢幣上印製著名的風景，也是世界上比較流行的做法，因為人們可以通過這些風景展示一個國家的形象。人民幣的反面也印製了中國非常著名的一些景點。
    在紙幣一百元上印製的是北京人民大會堂。人民大會堂位於天安門廣場的西面，是全國人民代表大會開會的地方。
    五十元紙幣上的風景是西藏的布達拉宮。布達拉宮是世界上海拔最高的建築，它建於1300年前，一共有1000間房屋。
    二十元紙幣上印著的是廣西的桂林山水。中國有句話——桂林山水甲天下，意思是桂林的風景是全國第一的。桂林也是很多人旅行計劃中必去的一個地方。
    十元紙幣上的風景是湖北的長江三峽。因為長江是中國的第一長河，長江三峽兩邊的山也非常雄奇。
    五元紙幣上印著的是山東的泰山。有一位著名詩人曾經說過：“登上了泰山後，再看其他山都覺得很小了。”
    一元紙幣上的風景是杭州西湖的三潭印月。三潭印月是西湖十景之一。據說在晚上月亮明亮的時候，潭裡的燈光會倒映在水面形成假月亮。水面上真真假假的月亮形成了一道迷人的風景線。
    這些就是人民幣紙幣上的風景了。如果你有機會，可以一一去看一下。你還可以拿出相應的人民幣與那裡的風景合影呢！

sentences.simplified: 它建于1300年前，一共有1000间房屋。
sentences.traditional: 它建於1300年前，一共有1000間房屋。

sentences.english: The Potala Palace is the building with the highest elevation above sea level in the world.
It was built 1,300 years ago, and has a total of 1,000 rooms.

sentences.traditional: 二十元紙幣上印著的是廣西的桂林山水。
sentences.pinyin: èr shí yuán zhǐ bì shang yìn zhe de shì guǎng xī de guì lín shān shuǐ

sentences.traditional: 中國有句話——桂林山水甲天下，意思是桂林的風景是全國第一的。

sentences.english: Printed on the 20 yuan note is the natural landscape of Guilin in Guangxi province.

sentences.simplified: 桂林也是很多人旅行计划中必去的一个地方。
sentences.traditional: 桂林也是很多人旅行計劃中必去的一個地方。
sentences.pinyin: guì lín yě shì hěn duō rén lǚ xíng jì huà zhōng bì qù de yí ge dì fang
sentences.english: There is a saying in China — Guilin’s scenery is first in the realm, meaning that Guilin’s scenery is the best in China.
Guilin is included in many people’s travel plans as a must visit destination.

sentences.simplified: 十元纸币上的风景是湖北的长江三峡。
sentences.traditional: 十元紙幣上的風景是湖北的長江三峽。

sentences.simplified: 长江三峡两边的山也非常雄奇。
sentences.traditional: 長江三峽兩邊的山也非常雄奇。
sentences.pinyin: cháng jiāng sān xiá liǎng biān de shān yě fēi cháng xióng qí
sentences.english: Because the Yangtze River is the longest river in China, ..
.. the mountains on both sides of the Three Gorges are also very majestic and unique.

sentences.simplified: 五元纸币上印着的是山东的泰山。
sentences.traditional: 五元紙幣上印著的是山東的泰山。
sentences.pinyin: wǔ yuán zhǐ bì shang yìn zhe de shì shān dōng de tài shān

sentences.traditional: 有一位著名詩人曾經說過：“登上了泰山後，再看其他山都覺得很小了。”

sentences.english: Printed on the five yuan note is Mount Tai in Shandong province.
A famous poet once said, “After climbing Mount Tai, any other mountain seems very small.”

sentences.simplified: 一元纸币上的风景是杭州西湖的三潭印月。
sentences.traditional: 一元紙幣上的風景是杭州西湖的三潭印月。
sentences.pinyin: yī yuán zhǐ bì shang de fēng jǐng shì háng zhōu xī hú de sān tán yìn yuè

sentences.simplified: 三潭印月是西湖十景之一。
sentences.traditional: 三潭印月是西湖十景之一。
sentences.pinyin: sān tán yìn yuè shì xī hú shí jǐng zhī yī
sentences.english: On the one yuan note is the Three Pools Mirroring the Moon at the West Lake in Hangzhou.

sentences.english: The Three Pools Mirroring the Moon is one of the ten scenes of the West Lake.

sentences.simplified: 潭里的灯光会倒映在水面形成假月亮。
sentences.traditional: 潭裡的燈光會倒映在水面形成假月亮。
sentences.pinyin: tán lǐ de dēng guāng huì dào yìng zài shuǐ miàn xíng chéng jiǎ yuè liang
sentences.english: It is said that at night when the moon is bright, ..

sentences.simplified: 水面上真真假假的月亮形成了一道迷人的风景线。
sentences.traditional: 水面上真真假假的月亮形成了一道迷人的風景線。
sentences.pinyin: shuǐ miàn shang zhēn zhēn jiǎ jiǎ de yuè liang xíng chéng le yí dào mí rén de fēng jǐng xiàn
sentences.english: .. the light in the pools is mirrored onto the surface of the water, producing an illusion of the moon.
The real moon and the illusion appearing together on the surface of the water create a fascinating landscape.

sentences.simplified: 这些就是人民币纸币上的风景了。如果你有机会，可以一一去看一下。
sentences.traditional: 這些就是人民幣紙幣上的風景了。如果你有機會，可以一一去看一下。
sentences.pinyin: zhè xiē jiù shì rén mín bì zhǐ bì shang de fēng jǐng le rú guǒ nǐ yǒu jī huì kě yǐ yī yī qù kàn yí xià

sentences.simplified: 你还可以拿出相应的人民币与那里的风景合影呢！
sentences.traditional: 你還可以拿出相應的人民幣與那裡的風景合影呢！
sentences.pinyin: nǐ hái kě yǐ ná chū xiāng yìng de rén mín bì yǔ nà lǐ de fēng jǐng hé yǐng ne
sentences.english: These are the landmarks on the Chinese renminbi banknotes. If you have the chance, you can visit each one.
You can also take out the matching renminbi banknote and take a photo of yourself with that landmark!

raw.synopsis: Learn about the various landmarks printed on Chinese banknotes.
sentence_translations: The Landmarks on Chinese Money
Money is a country’s “business card”.
Printing famous landmarks on banknotes is quite a popular thing to do around the world.
This is because people can present a country’s image through these landmarks.
The backs of renminbi banknotes also have some very famous Chinese landmarks printed on them.
Printed on the 100 yuan note is the Great Hall of the People in Beijing.
The Great Hall of the People is located at the western side of Tiananmen Square, ..
.. and is where the National People’s Congress holds meetings.
The landmark on the 50 yuan note is the Potala Palace in Tibet.
The Potala Palace is the building with the highest elevation above sea level in the world.
It was built 1,300 years ago, and has a total of 1,000 rooms.
Printed on the 20 yuan note is the natural landscape of Guilin in Guangxi province.
There is a saying in China — Guilin’s scenery is first in the realm, meaning that Guilin’s scenery is the best in China.
Guilin is included in many people’s travel plans as a must visit destination.
The landmark on the 10 yuan note is the Three Gorges in Hubei province.
Because the Yangtze River is the longest river in China, ..
.. the mountains on both sides of the Three Gorges are also very majestic and unique.
Printed on the five yuan note is Mount Tai in Shandong province.
A famous poet once said, “After climbing Mount Tai, any other mountain seems very small.”
On the one yuan note is the Three Pools Mirroring the Moon at the West Lake in Hangzhou.
The Three Pools Mirroring the Moon is one of the ten scenes of the West Lake.
It is said that at night when the moon is bright, ..
.. the light in the pools is mirrored onto the surface of the water, producing an illusion of the moon.
The real moon and the illusion appearing together on the surface of the water create a fascinating landscape.
These are the landmarks on the Chinese renminbi banknotes. If you have the chance, you can visit each one.
You can also take out the matching renminbi banknote and take a photo of yourself with that landmark!
